name: Step 5 Preview

lineage.how_derived: the card does not say how it was derived; the smaller relative in this database is step-3.7-flash (198B, 11B active)

purpose: The card calls it StepFun's flagship model for agentic work: repository-level software engineering, frontend and visual development, device programming, long-horizon tool-using execution and professional knowledge work, with particular strength in finance.

architecture.kind: multimodal sparse MoE with GQA full and sliding-window attention
architecture.attention: GQA, 64 heads with 4 KV groups, head dim 192, sliding window 512 for the sliding layers, head-wise attention gate, hidden 4096
architecture.drafter: 3 MTP layers in config (num_nextn_predict_layers 3); the card's serving commands use speculative decoding
architecture.why_this_design: The card gives no reasons for the architecture; config.json shows 89 MoE layers (3 to 90), 352 routed experts with top-8 plus a shared expert.

variants.notes: IQ3_M 271.61 GB, mmproj BF16 4.4 GB, imatrices with and without MTP; file sizes only

pc-12gb.notes: smallest GGUF 182.5 GB against about 60 GB

pc-32gb.notes: 182.5 GB against about 158 GB (29.6 VRAM + 128 RAM); about 150 GB would need a quant below the smallest published (roughly 2 bits per weight of 600B is 150 GB before KV)

engine_support.notes: Card documents FP8 on 4 B300 or 8 H200 GPUs and BF16 on 8 B300 or 16 H200 GPUs; a community GGUF exists but its llama.cpp compatibility was not checked.

strengths: Vendor positions it as frontier-level for software engineering and professional knowledge work; recommended sampling temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 0 (card)
weaknesses: The card's benchmark figure is an image; no numeric score was captured and no independent result found
soft.behavior: Results on the card use the High reasoning setting; GDPval-AA v2.1 numbers are from Artificial Analysis as of 2026-09-20; DeepSWE v1.1 with the SWE-agent harness.
soft.maturity: StepFun release line (Step-3.7-Flash is the smaller sibling); labelled Preview.

tona_fit.reason: 600B total / 27B active with a smallest quant of 182 GB: out of reach of every class including 32 GB VRAM + 128 GB RAM. It is a Preview with only image benchmarks. For StepFun users the practical model remains step-3.7-flash.
